title: Wedding Event Proximity Surcharge on Extra Fittings — Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry and Alterations
content:
An event-proximity surcharge is added to a Marlowe & Finch Alterations extra fitting booked close to the event of the customer's active Wedding Registry with the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry, counted in calendar days from today to the registry's event date.

| Calendar days from today to the active Wedding Registry's event date | Event-proximity surcharge |
|---|---|
| 0 to 21 | 5.00 USD |
| 22 to 45 | 3.00 USD |
| any other count, including an event date already passed | none |
| The customer holds no active Wedding Registry | none |

**Records read.** The customer's Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry registries: whether one is a Wedding Registry, whether it is active, and its event date. Other registry types do not enter this surcharge.

## Band edges, both sides

| Days to the event | Surcharge |
|---|---|
| 0 (event today) | 5.00 USD |
| 21 | 5.00 USD |
| 22 | 3.00 USD |
| 45 | 3.00 USD |
| 46 | none |
| event date yesterday | none |

## Hypothetical illustration

A bride whose active Wedding Registry shows an event 30 days from today books an extra fitting: 3.00 USD is added. A customer whose only active registry is a Baby Registry with an event 10 days away has no surcharge.
